shots.note: BLACK. PIP's amber lens blinks on; the first line is a light, not a mouth.
Jax in silhouette against the real Moon. Holds as PIP answers (listener).
credits: Lunar flyby visualisation: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio/Ernie Wright (a2_flyby_1min_2160p30), public domain per NASA media guidelines

shots.note: INSERT: engine readouts drop to zero; NAV follows.
Bridge wide, real Moon in the window. Screens die one by one.
credits: Lunar flyby visualisation: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio/Ernie Wright (a2_flyby_1min_2160p30), public domain per NASA media guidelines

shots.note: INSERT: the coffee machine's little green light goes out (LED is a light effect added to the set still).
Jax, alarm-red: 'They can't take the coffee machine.' (sample still, not yet a library ref)
PIP: 'It was financed separately.' Lens pulses with his speech.
A cheerful chime; the bank's smiling logo on the far monitor. Push in.
credits: Lunar flyby visualisation: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio/Ernie Wright (a2_flyby_1min_2160p30), public domain per NASA media guidelines

shots.note: Call window: TEMI ADEYEMI, headset, bright (one still).
MOTION (t1_jax, image-to-video): Jax bites, chews, stares at the sandwich while Temi talks; moving Moon in the window (per-frame key).
credits: Lunar flyby visualisation: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio/Ernie Wright (a2_flyby_1min_2160p30), public domain per NASA media guidelines

shots.note: Jax, all charm: 'Temi! Hi! I'm about to make a payment-'
A full second of nothing (frozen, blocky), then '-we disable your-'.
Jax silhouette, tighter: 'A big one. Enormous-'
credits: Lunar flyby visualisation: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio/Ernie Wright (a2_flyby_1min_2160p30), public domain per NASA media guidelines

shots.note: Reset: logo blinks, then 'Hello! You're speaking to Temi in Recoveries!'
Jax profile, to PIP: 'Why does she keep doing that?' (cropped clear of the reference's generated porthole Moon)
PIP, closer: 'She is in Lagos. You are arguing with the past.'
'And I'm winning.'
A soft old shop-door bell; PIP's lens swivels toward it (whip-pan into the lens).
The job: one parcel, sealed, prepaid. Shackleton crater by six tonight. The fee is-
'Is?' ... 'Exactly what we owe. To the cent.' Jax listening; 'Take it.'
credits: Lunar flyby visualisation: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio/Ernie Wright (a2_flyby_1min_2160p30), public domain per NASA media guidelines

shots.note: PIP lens ECU: 'You have not read the-'
'Take it take it take it take it-' Fast push.
INSERT: PIP's rubber-stamp arm comes down. THUNK. 'Accepted.'
PIP: 'I am also filing a report on you. Once is binding.'
INSERT: PIP's screen. REPORT #1,204 - RE: CAPTAIN. "TAKE IT" (x5).
One point three seconds. The left engine coughs back; lights, heating. Not the coffee (no green LED). Truck right with a foreground parallax layer.
credits: Lunar flyby visualisation: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio/Ernie Wright (a2_flyby_1min_2160p30), public domain per NASA media guidelines

shots.note: Jax off-screen: 'Who sends a parcel to a crater?' over a shadowed polar crater (NASA/GSFC visualisation).
credits: Shadowed crater: Dan Gallagher, Chris Smith (NASA/GSFC), 'The Moon's Permanently Shadowed Regions' (GSFC_20130306_Moons_m11218_Shadowed), public domain per NASA media guidelines

shots.note: INSERT: the cargo screen. A brown-paper parcel, soft at the corners.
Rack focus onto Jax looking at the parcel a moment too long. 'Lucky.' / 'Filed under "arithmetic".' Then SMASH.
MAIN TITLE over the Moon turning and filling the frame (NASA SVS flyby).
credits: Lunar flyby visualisation: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio/Ernie Wright (a2_flyby_1min_2160p30), public domain per NASA media guidelines
